item.coloph: mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' rab 'byams la shes pa'i snang ba skyes pa'i mkhas pa chen po de nyid las mnyan nas/ de nyid kyi zhal sngar shAkya'i dge slong spong zho gsal ba grags zhes bya bas/ yul dbus kyi grong khyer chen po mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas dpal nA len drar bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ dus phyis lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug stag sde pa chen po seng+ge rgyal mtshan gyis bka' drin dang / de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i blo gros kyi stobs kyis matha' yas pa'i shes bya'i chos la dbang sgyur ba shong ston lo tsA ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis legs par bshad pa'i srol la sogs pa las brten nas/ phyi dang nang gi gzhung lugs du ma rnams la bla'i snang ba char rgyas pa/zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba dpang dge slong dpal ldan blo gros brtan pas/ dge ba'i bshas gnyen dog shing dbon po dang / bde ba chos kyi bzang po la sogs pas/ mthun rkyen bsgrub pa la brten nas/ legs par bcos nas/ dag par bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ slar yang dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa de nyid kyis gzhungs 'di'i skabs su/ gzhung lugs gzhan gyi skabs mthun pa ji snyed snyed pa rnams sbyar zhing rgya dpe dang gtugs te legs par brtags shing dpyad nas zhu chen bgyisla/ don la'ang legs par dpyad pas shin tu dag par bgyis pa'o
